facts.fact: In 2020, more than 70% of US adults were listening to digital audio content at least once a month, according to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: In 2020, more than [70% of US adults](https://www.emarketer.com/content/impressive-resilience-of-digital-audio) were listening to digital audio content at least once a month.

facts.fact: In 2022, about 66% of the US population ages 12 and older listens to digital audio at least once per week, per Insider Intelligence as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: about [66%](https://www.insiderintelligence.com/content/us-population-listens-digital-audio) of the US population ages 12 and older listens to digital audio at least once per week.

facts.fact: US individuals spend on average 16 hours and 14 minutes per week listening to digital audio, per a Business2Community source cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Individuals in the US spend on average [16 hours and 14 minutes](https://www.business2community.com/digital-marketing/numbers-and-facts-you-need-to-know-about-audio-content-in-2021-02398919) per week listening to digital audio.

facts.fact: About one-third of US households are equipped with smart speakers, per Nielsen as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Today, [one-third](https://www.nielsen.com/us/en/insights/article/2020/more-than-dialed-in/) of US households are equipped with smart speakers

facts.fact: 44% of US adults use voice assistants, per StackAdapt's cited source.
facts.quote: and 44% of US adults use voice assistants.

facts.fact: Juniper Research predicts over 870 billion voice assistant-enabled devices will be used by US consumers in 2022, as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Juniper Research predicts that in [2022 over 870 billion voice assistant-enabled devices](https://www.alistdaily.com/lifestyle/smart-speaker-adoption-grows/)will be used by US consumers

facts.fact: 31% of digital audio listeners will access audio content via smart speakers, per eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: [31% of digital audio listeners](https://www.emarketer.com/content/digital-audio-advertising) will be accessing their audio content via smart speakers.

facts.fact: 65% of US podcast listeners use mobile to listen to podcasts, versus 14% on laptop or desktop, per a 2019 Edison Research study cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: [65% of US podcast listeners](https://www.edisonresearch.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/Infinite-Dial-2019-PDF-1.pdf) use mobile to listen to podcasts, versus 14% on laptop or desktop.

facts.fact: 25% of podcast listeners use a desktop or laptop to listen to podcasts, per Edison Research as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Edison Research finds that [25% of podcast listeners](https://www.edisonresearch.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/Infinite-Dial-2019-PDF-1.pdf) do use a desktop or laptop to listen to podcasts.

facts.fact: Programmatic audio ads are typically between 15 seconds and 1 minute long, per StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Typically, audio ads are between 15 seconds and 1 minute long.

facts.fact: Audio companion banners are clickable visual ads displayed for the duration of an audio ad while it plays on mobile or desktop, per StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Audio companion ads, also known as [audio companion banners], are clickable, visual ads that run at the same time as an audio ad.
